column1: # The game's own Lua natives, read from the TU1 binary (Fable2TU1): table
# Every mod/init.lua runs in this VM after the shipped scripts, so all of these are callable; the
# per-class tables (Player, Dog, Creature ...) are methods on the component's Lua object, _G
# entries are globals, *Metatable entries are methods of that userdata (EntityMetatable = an entity).
